title: .kritika.yaml
description: A repository's kritika configuration, read from the merge base. See docs/repository-config.md.

enabled.description: false stops reviews, follow-ups and indexing; true cannot turn a disabled repository on.

feedback.description: How much the review says: detailed, anything a maintainer could act on, every finding inline; standard, the same with nits kept to the summary; minimal, only bugs, risks and breaking changes.

fixes.description: true requires a suggested fix on every finding; false cannot lift the admin's requirement.

approve.description: true approves a pull request whose review finds nothing blocking or important, or, with a confidence score, whose score reaches the threshold and whose risk is within confidence.risk; a later review that no longer allows it dismisses the approval; replaces the admin's.

diagram.description: true has the summary draw the flow the change adds or alters as a Mermaid diagram; replaces the admin's.

confidence.description: How a review is judged: a second model scores the reviewed pull request from 0 to 5.

model.description: The model that scores a reviewed pull request, replacing the admin's.

threshold.description: The score a pull request must reach to be approved and, with gate, for its commit status to pass, replacing the admin's.

gate.description: true fails the commit status under the threshold, so it can be a required check; replaces the admin's.

risk.description: The highest risk a change may be rated and still be approved; it may only lower the admin's.

trigger.description: Which pull requests get a review.

include.description: Conditions that let a pull request in: it is reviewed when any of them holds, or the list is empty, and no exclude condition does. It must pass the admin's lists as well.

exclude.description: Conditions that keep a pull request out: it is skipped when any of them holds, whatever include says. A skip names the condition that held when it has a name.

ignore.description: Globs of paths kritika leaves out of a review's context and of the index, added to the admin's; a pull request that changes only ignored paths is skipped.

summary.description: A repository file, read from the merge base, that replaces the summary comment's template.

finding.description: A repository file, read from the merge base, that replaces an inline finding's template.

rules.description: Checks the review makes, added after the admin's. A rule may not reuse the id of an admin's.

id.description: Names the rule to the findings that cite it.

file.description: A repository file, read from the merge base, whose content is the check.

paths.description: Apply the rule only when a changed path matches one of these.

when.description: Conditions on the pull request: the rule applies only when one of them holds.

context.description: Files that explain the code, added after the admin's.

paths.description: Name the file only when a changed path matches one of these.

skills.description: The repository's Agent Skills: folders holding a SKILL.md, read from the merge base. A review is offered each one's name and description and reads the skill when it fits.

paths.description: The directories whose folders each hold a skill, replacing the admin's; .agents/skills and .claude/skills when no one sets them, and an empty list turns skills off.

scope.description: Narrows when a skill is offered, by the skill's name; added to the admin's, a skill named in both taking this file's.

paths.description: Offer the skill only when a changed path matches one of these.

when.description: Conditions on the pull request: the skill is offered only when one of them holds.

condition.description: One condition on a pull request, in trigger.include or trigger.exclude: expr, paths, or both, when both must hold. One with paths, or whose expr reads pr.lines, is judged once the pull request's diff is fetched.

name.description: What the condition is called where a skip names it, unique in its list; it may not be one an admin's condition has.

expr.description: A CEL expression over pr that says whether the condition holds. pr.lines is the lines the diff adds and removes, ignored paths left out.

paths.description: The condition holds only when a changed path matches one of these.

when.description: One condition on a pull request, in a rule's or a skill scope's when.

expr.description: A CEL expression over pr, as a trigger.include or trigger.exclude expression sees it, without pr.lines.

model.description: A <provider>/<model> reference, of a provider the instance or the account declares.

path.description: A path relative to the repository root.

glob.description: A doublestar glob, such as docs/** or **/*.sql.
